c1._note: 4 cells per arm (8 turns each). cross_turn_by_file and after_own_edit split are sums; out_cost_mean is mean output cost per cell at peak; first_calc counts the first access to calc.py in a turn that was a read, full or windowed; edit_before_read counts edits in turns 2-8 of a file not yet read or successfully edited in that turn; refusal_turn_steps lists (turn, step) of FS_NOT_OBSERVED refusals per cell
